about_the_game:
Composed by Arnaud Roy (a.k.a Flybyno), the Endless Legend ""Definitive Edition"" OST Includes 51 tracks in lossless .wav format covering the game and every released expansions.
"Enter the world of Auriga with Endless Legend by Arnaud Roy. The award-winning soundtrack to Amplitude Studios' incredible 4X strategy game is here to serenade you in its Endless grooves. Dreamy and transient in its execution, Arnaud & the Scoring Orchestra are here to take you on an unforgettable and fantastical journey through one of the most expansive game scores ever made." - Jacob at
